requirements_summary: Workload: mix of batch (nightly bulk re-index ~1M docs / month) + realtime (50 QPS embedding upsert during day)
Performance targets: embedding latency <= 50ms p50, <= 120ms p99 for hosted call; search/nearest-neighbor query p95 < 100ms (end-to-end)
Throughput: sustained 50 QPS for online embeddings; burst to 200 QPS for release windows. Batch throughput goal: finish 1.2M docs re-ingest in <24 hours if possible.
Vector DB: needs example integration pattern with Pinecone; cost/ops tradeoff for Milvus (self-hosted) considered for Dedicated/private later.
Durability/retention: keep vectors for 3 years; retention controls and export tools required.
Security: SSO (SAML) for console; API keys + KMS for key rotation; audit logs retained 90 days then archived.
Routing/fallback: prefer automatic fallback to smaller/cheaper model during capacity constraints; want policy controls in Console.
Cost sensitivity: looking to cap per-customer monthly inference spend; need tools to allocate and tag usage by tenant.
poc_plan: Week 0: provide Redwood Hosted API creds + sample ingestion scripts; baseline embed latency + cost metric collection.
Week 1: run batch job to ingest 250k docs/day; measure token/embedding throughput and end-to-end indexing time (Pinecone test index).
Week 2: ramp online QPS to 50 sustained; run simulated release-day burst to 200 QPS; measure p50/p95/p99 latencies and cache hit-%.
Deliverables: latency/cost report, recommended batching/cache configs, Dedicated sizing options (GPU pool estimate), estimated monthly cost for projected volume.
Success criteria: embedding p99 <= 120ms on Hosted; batch full ingest for 1.2M docs completes in <48h; vector storage + query infra under projected cost envelope.
